FIRMS INTERESTED IN OBTAINING REGISTRATION WITH SAIL MAY SUBMIT THE VENDOR REGISTRATION FORM AVAILABLE ON THE SAIL TENDERS PORTAL AND COMPLETE THE PRESCRIBED REGISTRATION PROCESS WITH THE CONCERNED SAIL PLANT/UNIT.
